help_1c_steps: Open the list of bank transactions for the period — e.g. “Bank and cash → Bank statements”.
Output the list as a table: “More → Output list…”.
Save the table as Excel (.xlsx) and upload it here.
help_bank_steps: Open the statement for your business account and choose the period.
Press “Export” or “Save” and choose Excel or CSV.
If only PDF is offered, a text PDF works — not a scan or a photo.
upload.help_requirements: The file needs a date, an amount and the direction (in/out, or the sign of the amount). Categories help: without them the expense analysis stays general.
